title: Tenma Saki — You're Really Buff Now?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally... Homeroom's over...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki!
Did homeroom for Class C also just end?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! But Ichi's gotta stay behind for classroom duties. She might be awhile.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...
We'll have to wait for Shiho too. Homeroom for Class A still hasn't finished yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, is Ichika's finger okay now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She showed me earlier and it's completely healed!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness... I was sort of startled when I heard about what happened in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was kinda shocked when I heard that you broke one of your drumsticks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I didn't break it. I actually just cracked it a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! I was totally under the impression that you'd gotten so buff that you'd snapped it in half!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, you may be right. My arms do feel a little stronger now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I can drum for a long time now without feeling fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so cool! It means real changes are happening!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not sure if this is related, but my upper arm also seems a little slimmer now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm actually happy that it's gone from being a bit flabby to being toned.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona!
Mind if I feel your arm?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...
It really does feel toned...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Now try flexing for me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hnng!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!!
This is so cool! Hona, your arm's rock solid!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna try doing that too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hnng!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guh! It still feels soft...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I've been doing my best every day... I guess this means I need to practice more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure there's much you can do about that since playing the synthesizer doesn't involve using many big muscles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, outward physical changes aren't the only thing that shows how hard you've been working.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, Saki, you always stay and practice until really late, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! How do you know about that, Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This one time, when I went to talk to MEIKO about staying behind to practice, I heard the sound of someone playing the synthesizer coming from afar.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That really encouraged me and made me want to try harder.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you! I love you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wah! Oh, Saki...
You just can't help it during moments like these, can you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because you're too nice, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm really glad.
Your cheeks are as soft as ever♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna rub-a-dub-dub them even more!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Hehe!
Wait, Saki, that tickles...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Well-toned muscles are nice, but I think I prefer it if the rest of you stays soft and cuddly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Hmm... Really?
I'd rather not be too soft...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing to her, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm getting my fill of how muscly and cuddly Hona is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm not sure either, but there's quite a few other people watching.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
No! Hona's all mine! They can't have her!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um...
I don't think that's why they were watching...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, shall we get to training?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!
